resolved_findings.issue: Repeated local persistence failure could let an untrusted IO error escape the exported runner when catch attempted to persist again.
resolved_findings.regression_case: Malicious persistent local IO diagnostics do not escape the exported runner
resolved_findings.fix: The persistence helper now converts every local IO or clock failure into a fixed StudyError without raw diagnostics.
resolved_findings.verification: The independent suite recorded 28/29 before the fix and 29/29 on the reviewed final source.
